method: Static source registration inventory of unique METHOD + /api path patterns; GET-implied HEAD, gateway proxies, Web static/fallback handlers and /internal service RPC excluded. Not runtime ServeMux enumeration or HTTPS coverage.

classification.admin: All /api/admin routes plus POST /api/auth/step-up and PUT /api/capabilities/{name}; excluded from ordinary metric
classification.experimental: exportRoutes called only under Config.ExperimentalExports in Handler; default false
classification.ordinary: Remaining public business registration patterns, including feature-gated routes; not a deployed or tested-coverage claim
